I was 30 and had been in a stable relationship for five years. My partner and I decided to try MDMA and then mushrooms together at home, as a kind of relationship-deepening experience, after reading about couples doing this. The MDMA part was lovely, we talked about our feelings and felt very close. When the mushrooms kicked in, about two hours later, things changed.

I started seeing my partner as a stranger. Not in a paranoid way at first, more like I was seeing her clearly for the first time, and she was someone I didn't know at all. Then I started remembering every small hurt between us, every time she'd dismissed me, every argument, every disappointment, and they piled up into a mountain. I felt that I'd been lying to myself for five years and that our relationship was empty.

I told her this. I said things I'd never said before, cruel things, and at the time they felt like the truth. She started crying. She said things back. Her face kept changing, sometimes it was her, sometimes it was my mother, sometimes it was a skull. I felt that I was drowning in a flood of resentment that had been waiting for this moment.

Then I started to dissolve. I didn't know if I was the one speaking or if the words were coming through me from somewhere else. I felt that I had no self, just a collection of old injuries. I lay on the floor and couldn't move for a long time. She sat on the sofa crying, and we didn't touch for hours.

In the morning we were both exhausted and raw. We didn't know how to go back to normal. We broke up three months later. I still don't know if the mushrooms showed us something true, or if they created a truth that hadn't been there before.

Ich habe auf einem Festival LSD genommen und mich in der Menge verloren. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass alle Menschen um mich herum zu einer einzigen Masse verschmelzen und ich darin ersticke. Ich habe mich zum Rand gekämpft und bin über einen Zaun geklettert, um rauszukommen, dabei habe ich mir die Hand aufgerissen. Draußen bin ich im Dunkeln über ein Feld gerannt, bis ich nicht mehr konnte. Ich habe die ganze Nacht allein in einem Graben gesessen und darauf gewartet, dass es aufhört.

I'd been struggling with anorexia for years and was in recovery. A friend suggested psilocybin could help with body image. I took a moderate dose at her place. Instead of helping, it made my body grotesque. I looked down and my stomach was swelling and bulging, my thighs were growing, my skin was rippling with fat. I knew rationally that I was very thin, but I saw myself as monstrously huge. I ran to the bathroom and tried to make myself sick, for the first time in a year. I was screaming at my reflection. My friend tried to calm me but I pushed her away. The visions went on for hours.

Ich hatte zusammen mit einem Freund LSD genommen, als wir in seiner Wohnung einen Anruf von seiner Mutter bekommen haben, dass sein Vater gestorben ist. Mein Freund ist völlig zusammengebrochen, hat geschrien und um sich geschlagen. Ich musste ihn halten und war selbst kaum bei Sinnen. Die Trauer meines Freundes hat sich angefühlt wie meine eigene, und ich hatte das Gefühl, dass auch mein Vater gestorben ist. Wir saßen stundenlang auf dem Boden und haben geweint. Am nächsten Morgen sind wir zusammen zu seiner Familie gefahren, beide völlig fertig.

Smoked DMT. The entities told me I'd been there before and that I'd forgotten on purpose because what I'd learned was too terrible. Then they showed me. I can't describe it. Something about the nature of suffering and that it never ends. Came back sobbing.

My first LSD experience was with my older brother when I was 17. He thought it would be a bonding experience. Around the peak, he started telling me family secrets: that our father had an affair, that our parents almost divorced, that our mother had attempted suicide when I was a baby. I had no idea about any of it. I couldn't process it. The walls were breathing and my brother's face kept changing, and these terrible truths were coming out of his mouth like black smoke. I felt that the floor of my whole life had fallen away. I asked him to stop and he kept going, I think because he was tripping too and felt he had to get it out. I went into the garden and lay in the grass for hours, staring at the sky, feeling that nothing I believed about my family was real. My parents came home in the evening and I couldn't look at them. I went to my room and pretended to be sick.

Ich bin Krankenschwester und habe in meiner Freizeit Pilze genommen, an einem Wochenende allein zu Hause. Während des Trips musste ich an eine Patientin denken, die in meiner Schicht gestorben war, eine junge Mutter. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass sie im Raum ist und mich anschaut, mit vorwurfsvollen Augen. Ich habe mich gefragt, ob ich etwas übersehen habe, ob ich schuld bin. Das Gefühl wurde immer stärker, bis ich das Gefühl hatte, dass alle Patienten, die je auf meiner Station gestorben sind, im Raum stehen. Ich habe mich unter der Bettdecke versteckt und stundenlang geweint. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass ich das nie wieder loswerde.

I'd heard that 'tripping in a hospital setting' was safe, so I signed up for a ketamine trial for depression. During the infusion I felt myself being pulled out of my body and into a space that looked like an endless hospital corridor. I walked and walked and every door led to another corridor. I became sure I'd died on the table and that this corridor was where people go who die in hospitals. When I came back, the research nurse was smiling and asking me to rate my experience on a scale. I couldn't speak. I was terrified that I'd go back there.

LSD mit Freunden, schöner Abend, bis ich plötzlich überzeugt war, dass meine Mutter gestorben ist. Ich habe sie mitten in der Nacht angerufen und geweint. Sie war natürlich völlig verwirrt und erschrocken.

I used to be a very rational person who saw psychedelics as just a chemical curiosity. I took a large dose of mushrooms with friends at a holiday rental. At some point I closed my eyes and found myself in front of an enormous being, made of light and eyes and wings, the kind of thing you see in medieval paintings of angels. It was so huge and so overwhelming that I felt crushed by its presence. It looked at me and I felt it knew everything about me, every thought I'd ever had, and it was not pleased. It said, without words, 'you have wasted your life'. I fell to my knees, physically, in the room. My friends said I was on the floor for an hour, crying and apologising to nobody. I felt as if my whole worldview had been smashed. I didn't know what was real anymore. I had no framework for what happened. It was beyond terrifying.
Took LSD at home, got stuck in a thought loop about whether I'd locked the door. Checked it maybe 200 times. Each time I wasn't sure if I'd really checked. Exhausting and horrible.

Ich habe mit 16 auf einer Klassenfahrt zum ersten Mal Pilze genommen. Ein Mitschüler hatte sie besorgt. Ich bin mit zwei anderen in den Wald gegangen. Nach einer Stunde hatte ich das Gefühl, dass die Bäume mich festhalten wollen. Ich habe mich verlaufen und bin stundenlang durch den Wald geirrt. Die Lehrer haben eine Suchaktion gestartet, und ich wurde schließlich von der Polizei gefunden, nachts, zitternd und völlig verwirrt. Danach gab es riesigen Ärger, mit der Schule, mit meinen Eltern und mit der Polizei.
